strings.string: Minutes:seconds per mile or km, in your watch's pace units, e.g. 9:00. Drives the ON PACE band, AHEAD/BEHIND and alerts when no workout target is active. Leave blank for none.
How far from the goal pace still counts as ON PACE. Default 10 seconds per mile/km.
Vibrate when you drift off pace
Goal pace only (workouts alert on their own)

Official race distance in your watch's distance units, e.g. 13.11 for a half marathon in miles or 21.1 in km. The finish then reads exactly this even if the course file measures a little long or short. Only applies when the loaded course is within 5% of it. Set back to 0 after the race.
ON PACE band: seconds of pace to average
Default 30. Higher is steadier but slower to react.
